verses.sanskrit: क्ष्माम्भोऽग्निक्ष्माऽम्बुतेजःखवाय्वग्न्यनिलगोनिलैः द्वयोल्बणैः क्रमाद्भूतैर्मधुरादिरसोद्भवः ॥१॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 1 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां विद्याद्रसं स्वादुं यो वक्त्रमनुलिम्पति आस्वाद्यमानो देहस्य ह्लादनोऽक्षप्रसादनः ॥२॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 2 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियः पिपीलिकादीनामम्लः क्षालयते मुखम् हर्षणो रोमदन्तानामक्षिभ्रुवनिकोचनः ॥३॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 3 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: लवणः स्यन्दयत्यास्यं कपोलगलदाहकृत् तिक्तो विशदयत्यास्यं रसनं प्रतिहन्ति च ॥४॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 4 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेजयति जिह्वाग्रं कुर्वंश्चिमिचिमां कटुः स्रावत्यक्षिनासास्यं कपोलौ दहतीव च ॥५॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 5 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: कषायो जडयेज्जिह्वां कण्ठस्रोतोविबन्धकृत् रसानामिति रूपाणि कर्माणि मधुरो रसः ॥६॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 6 explains the origin, sensory character and immediate oral effects of the six rasas.

verses.sanskrit: आजन्मसात्म्यात्कुरुते धातूनां प्रबलं बलम् बालवृद्धक्षतक्षीणवर्णकेशेन्द्रियौजसाम् ॥७॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 7 explains madhura rasa, including its nourishing, strengthening and beneficial actions, followed by harms of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशस्तो बृंहणः कण्ठ्यः स्तन्यसन्धानकृद्गुरुः आयुष्यो जीवनः स्निग्धः पित्तानिलविषापहः ॥८॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 8 explains madhura rasa, including its nourishing, strengthening and beneficial actions, followed by harms of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुतेऽत्युपयोगेन स मेदःश्लेष्मजान् गदान् स्थौल्याग्निसादसंन्यासमेहगण्डार्बुदादिकान् ॥९॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 9 explains madhura rasa, including its nourishing, strengthening and beneficial actions, followed by harms of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: अम्लोऽग्निदीप्तिकृत्स्निग्धो हृद्यः पाचनरोचनः उष्णवीर्यो हिमस्पर्शः प्रीणनः क्लेदनो लघुः ॥१०॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 10 explains amla rasa, its digestive and satisfying actions, and effects of excessive habitual use.

verses.sanskrit: करोति कफपित्तास्रं मूढवातानुलोमनः सोऽत्यभ्यस्तस्तनोः कुर्याच्छैथिल्यं तिमिरं भ्रमम् ॥११॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 11 explains amla rasa, its digestive and satisfying actions, and effects of excessive habitual use.

verses.sanskrit: कण्डूपाण्डुत्ववीसर्पशोफविस्फोटतृड्ज्वरान् लवणः स्तम्भसङ्घातबन्धविध्मापनोऽग्निकृत् ॥१२॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 12 explains lavana rasa, its digestive, oleating and channel-opening actions, and harms of excess.

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहनः स्वेदनस्तीक्ष्णो रोचनश्छेदभेदकृत् सोऽतियुक्तोऽस्रपवनं खलतिं पलितं वलिम् ॥१३॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 13 explains lavana rasa, its digestive, oleating and channel-opening actions, and harms of excess.

verses.sanskrit: तृट्कुष्ठविषवीसर्पान्जनयेत्क्षपयेद्बलम् तिक्तः स्वयमरोचिष्णुररुचिं कृमितृड्विषम् ॥१४॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 14 explains tikta rasa, its reducing, cleansing and kapha-pitta pacifying actions, and effects of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: कुष्ठमूर्च्छाज्वरोत्क्लेशदाहपित्तकफान् जयेत् क्लेदमेदोवसामज्जशकृन्मूत्रोपशोषणः ॥१५॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 15 explains tikta rasa, its reducing, cleansing and kapha-pitta pacifying actions, and effects of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: लघुर्मेध्यो हिमो रूक्षः स्तन्यकण्ठविशोधनः धातुक्षयानिलव्याधीनतियोगात्करोति सः ॥१६॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 16 explains tikta rasa, its reducing, cleansing and kapha-pitta pacifying actions, and effects of excessive use.

verses.sanskrit: कटुर्गलामयोदर्दकुष्ठालसकशोफजित् व्रणावसादनः स्नेहमेदःक्लेदोपशोषणः ॥१७॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 17 explains katu rasa, its digestive, channel-clearing and kapha-reducing actions, and harms of excess.

verses.sanskrit: दीपनः पाचनो रुच्यः शोधनोऽन्नस्य शोषणः छिनत्ति बन्धान् स्रोतांसि विवृणोति कफापहः ॥१८॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 18 explains katu rasa, its digestive, channel-clearing and kapha-reducing actions, and harms of excess.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुते सोऽतियोगेन तृष्णां शुक्रबलक्षयम् मूर्च्छामाकुञ्चनं कम्पं कटिपृष्ठादिषु व्यथाम् ॥१९॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 19 explains katu rasa, its digestive, channel-clearing and kapha-reducing actions, and harms of excess.

verses.sanskrit: कषायः पित्तकफहा गुरुरस्रविशोधनः पीडनो रोपणः शीतः क्लेदमेदोविशोषणः ॥२०॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 20 explains kashaya rasa, its astringent, cooling, absorbent and drying actions, and effects of excessive habitual use.

verses.sanskrit: आमसंस्तम्भनो ग्राही रूक्षोऽति त्वक्प्रसादनः करोति शीलितोऽति विष्टम्भाध्मानहृद्रुजः ॥२१॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 21 explains kashaya rasa, its astringent, cooling, absorbent and drying actions, and effects of excessive habitual use.

verses.sanskrit: तृट्कार्श्यपौरुषभ्रंशस्रोतोरोधमलग्रहान् घृतहेमगुडाक्षोडमोचचोचपरूषकम् ॥२२॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 22 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: अभीरुवीरापनसराजादनबलात्रयम् मेदे चतस्रः पर्णिन्यो जीवन्तीजीवकर्षभौ ॥२३॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 23 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: मधूकं मधुकं बिम्बी विदारी श्रावणीयुगम् क्षीरशुक्ला तुगाक्षीरी क्षीरिण्यौ काश्मरी सहे ॥२४॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 24 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरेक्षुगोक्षुरक्षौद्रद्राक्षादिर्मधुरो गणः अम्लो धात्रीफलाम्लीकामातुलुङ्गाम्लवेतसम् ॥२५॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 25 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: दाडिमं राजतं तक्रं चुक्रं पालेवतं दधि आम्रमाम्रातकं भव्यं कपित्थं करमर्दकम् ॥२६॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 26 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: वरं सौवर्चलं कृष्णं बिडं सामुद्रमौद्भिदम् रोमकं पांसुजं शीसं क्षारश्च लवणो गणः ॥२७॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 27 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: तिक्तः पटोलीत्रायन्तीवालकोशीरचन्दनम् भूनिम्बनिम्बकटुकातगरागुरुवत्सकम् ॥२८॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 28 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: नक्तमालद्विरजनीमुस्तमूर्वाटरूषकम् पाठापामार्गकांस्यायोगुडूचीधन्वयासकम् ॥२९॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 29 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमूलं महद्व्याघ्र्यौ विशालाऽतिविषा वचा कटुको हिङ्गुमरिचकृमिजित्पञ्चकोलकम् ॥३०॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 30 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: कुठेराद्या हरितकाः पित्तं मूत्रमरुष्करम् वर्गः कषायः पथ्याऽक्षशिरीषः खदिरो मधु ॥३१॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 31 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बोदुम्बरं मुक्ताप्रवालाञ्जनगैरिकम् बालं कपित्थं खर्जूरं बिसपद्मोत्पलादि च ॥३२॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 32 lists classical examples of substances belonging predominantly to the indicated rasa group.

verses.sanskrit: मधुरं श्लेष्मलं प्रायो जीर्णाच्छालियवादृते मुद्गाद्गोधूमतः क्षौद्रात्सिताया जाङ्गलामिषात् ॥३३॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 33 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायोऽम्लपित्तजननं दाडिमामलकादृते अपथ्यं लवणं प्रायश्चक्षुषोऽन्यत्र सैन्धवात् ॥३४॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 34 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: तिक्तं कटु च भूयिष्ठमवृष्यं वातकोपनम् ऋतेऽमृतापटोलीभ्यां शुण्ठीकृष्णारसोनतः ॥३५॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 35 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: कषायं प्रायशः शीतं स्तम्भनं चाभयां विना रसाः कट्वम्ललवणा वीर्येणोष्णा यथोत्तरम् ॥३६॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 36 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: तिक्तः कषायो मधुरस्तद्वदेव च शीतलाः तिक्तः कटुः कषायश्च रूक्षा बद्धमलास्तथा ॥३७॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 37 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: पट्वम्लमधुराः स्निग्धाः सृष्टविण्मूत्रमारुताः पटोः कषायस्तस्माच्च मधुरः परमं गुरुः ॥३८॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 38 gives general dietary tendencies of the six rasas, including their effects on doshas, virya, dryness, unctuousness and elimination.

verses.sanskrit: लघुरम्लः कटुस्तस्मात्तस्मादपि च तिक्तकः संयोगाः सप्तपञ्चाशत्कल्पना तु त्रिषष्टिधा ॥३९॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 39 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

verses.sanskrit: रसानां यौगिकत्वेन यथास्थूलं विभज्यते एकैकहीनास्तान् पञ्चदश यान्ति रसा द्विके ॥४०॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 40 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिके स्वादुर्दशाम्लः षट् त्रीन् पटुस्तिक्त एककम् चतुष्केषु दश स्वादुश्चतुरोऽम्लः पटुः सकृत् ॥४१॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 41 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चकेष्वेकमेवाम्लो मधुरः पञ्च सेवते द्रव्यमेकं षडास्वादमसंयुक्ताश्च षड्रसाः ॥४२॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 42 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

verses.sanskrit: षट् पञ्चकाः षट् च पृथग्रसाः स्युश्चतुर्द्विकौ पञ्चदशप्रकारौ भेदास्त्रिका विंशतिरेकमेव द्रव्यं षडास्वादमिति त्रिषष्टिः ॥४३॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 43 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

verses.sanskrit: ते रसानुरसतो रसभेदा स्तारतम्यपरिकल्पनया च सम्भवन्ति गणनां समतीता दोषभेषजवशादुपयोज्याः ॥४४॥
verses.student_meaning: Verse 44 explains the mathematical enumeration and clinical usefulness of rasa combinations, including anurasa and gradations of predominance.

learning_outcomes: Define rasa and explain its Panchamahabhuta basis.
Describe the sensory characteristics of the six rasas.
Explain the principal actions and excessive-use effects of each rasa.
Identify classical examples of dravyas belonging to each rasa group.
Explain the general doshic, virya and guna tendencies of the six rasas.
Explain the enumeration of two-, three-, four-, five- and six-rasa combinations.
Explain why anurasa and degree of predominance make practical rasa combinations effectively innumerable.
exam_focus: Panchamahabhuta basis of the six rasas.
Properties and actions of each rasa.
Atiyoga and adverse effects of each rasa.
Classical dravya groups for the six rasas.
Enumeration of rasa combinations in verses 39–43.
Clinical application of anurasa and taratamya in verse 44.

source_text.verification_note: Chapter 10 begins at verse 1 and ends at verse 44; the chapter colophon follows verse 44 and Chapter 11 begins immediately thereafter.

revision_summary: Learn the six rasa names and their elemental origins.
Make a table of each rasa's major guna, virya, dosha action and excess effects.
Practice the combination-counting logic in verses 39–43.
Understand anurasa and taratamya as the reason practical rasa variants exceed simple numerical combinations.
